messages:
alisa: Observability spike: recurring missing spans concentrated on a subset of shards. Seen 3x in past week. Opening thread to assign owners+remediations.

alisa: Symptom: aggregator index shows dropped spans for shard-13 and shard-17 between 02:10-03:20 UTC. Raw-span store has the data.

dan: any logs showing consumer backpressure or flow-control errors?

alisa: snippet: ```
2026-04-10T02:11:05Z consumer-13 WARN slow-consume: buffer-full
2026-04-10T02:11:06Z consumer-13 INFO checkpoint commit skipped due to busy-pool
2026-04-10T02:11:08Z consumer-13 ERROR commit failed: Timeout
```

tommy: sounds like shard affinity + busy thread-pool causing commit skips. If checkpoint not committed before reassignment, spans are not marked as materialized.

rachel: we also saw the avg write latency to object store spike to 2s at that time; combined effect plausible.

alisa: proposed immediate actions: 1) add metric for commit-skip-rate and shard-specific missing-span delta (owner: rachel, ETA: EOD) 2) hotfix: reduce consumer thread-pool saturation by increasing pool size and adding backpressure shedding (owner: dan, ETA: 12h) 3) reconciliation job to diff raw-store vs aggregator and backfill shards with deltas (owner: tommy, ETA: spike 3 days).

dan: I'll open a PR to bump pool size and add guarded commits with retry/backoff. Will include unit+integrations.

tommy: reconciliation spike: plan to scan per-shard index for last 72h and publish idempotent backfill tasks. Will include rate-limits to avoid overload.

rachel: adding dashboard tiles for shard-commit-skip and shard-missing-pct. Also alert: shard-missing-pct > 0.5% for 30m -> page ingestion oncall.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INFR-5012 "Shard affinity + consumer saturation causing missing spans". Assigned to @dan, @rachel, @tommy. Weekly follow-ups scheduled.

alisa: QA plan for hotfix: 1) run synthetic load targeting shard-13/17 2) force consumer rebalance 3) assert no missing spans for 5k requests 4) monitor new metrics.

dan: PR opened: https://git.internal/etl/consumer/pulls/342  includes pool-size config and retry wrapper. Requesting review.

tommy: ran staging spike: reconciliation job produced 4 backfill tasks and restored ~2.1% missing spans for the window tested.

rachel: dashboard shows commit-skip-rate dropped to zero after staging merge. Setting canary in prod (10% for 30m).

dan: canary started. No alerts 25m in. Increasing to 50% then 100% if stable.

ops-bot: Deploy event: consumer-service v3.4.1-canary by @dan.

dan: full rollout complete at 2026-04-10T20:05:00Z. No regressions detected.

alisa: follow-ups: - rachel: keep shard metrics & alert for 4 weeks - tommy: complete reconciliation backfill + daily run for 3 days - dan: postmortem + include consumer pool autoscale guidance (EOD tomorrow)

alisa: closing thread for active ops. Please link regressions to INFR-5012. :white_check_mark:
